about: US-SPEC-01 section 4.2: the L2 records and the seed tables that hold them. The specification's column names are illustrative and the roles of the tables are normative (US-00-R06), so this file is the published mapping. l1.test.js applies every module migration and fails if a table named here is missing. A record with no seed table is listed under missing with the reason; one the router carries as configuration is under mapped_by_config; the platform kernel's own tables are under seed.

missing.model_task_matrix: the model for each kind of task is configuration read by core/router (router.rungs and providers), not a stored table; mapped_by_config names the configuration and the table that logs each call

model_task_matrix.config: core/router/router.js reads config.rungs and config.providers (each provider names its models)

seed.about: The seed (seed/worker, the platform kernel) keeps some of these records in its own schema. Applied by l1.test.js when ../seed/worker/migrations exists; a record absent here is not claimed for the seed.
